canonical_statement: For a Borel probability measure mu on the real line and a < b with no atom at either endpoint, the mass mu((a,b]) is recovered as the limit, as T tends to positive infinity, of (1/(2*pi)) times the integral from -T to T of ((exp(-i*t*a)-exp(-i*t*b))/(i*t)) times the characteristic function of mu at t.
